decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that extends the firm’s core plant-equipment offering, it is still in the option-evaluation phase, and despite some risk from the firm’s recent pruning of other automation products, its strategic fit supports keeping it on the market for now.

Because this production analysis software is close to the firm’s established automation and lifecycle-support business and is relatively inexpensive to keep available while customer feedback accumulates, management would keep it rather than abandon it now.
